newsitem.title: GREECE: NATIONAL BANK UPGRADES SAFE DEPOSIT SERVICES.
newsitem.headline: NATIONAL BANK UPGRADES SAFE DEPOSIT SERVICES.

text.p: State National Bank of Greece has adopted a series of measures to upgrade its safe deposit services, it said on Friday.
National Bank is installing electronic safe deposit service in 18 of its branches across the country where clients will no longer need assistance by bank personnel and use a code number.
It is also installing robotic safe deposit boxes in its branch in Vouliagmeni at Leoforos Athinon 41. These will be operational in early October, it said.
The bank claims the country's largest network of safe deposit service as it is available in 120 of its branches nationwide.
All clients are offered free safe deposit insurance coverage up to one million drachmas for the contents of their safe deposit box, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
